description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including datasource configuration, JPA dialect, schema, and SQL changes, and authenticate using managed identity.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC configuration, dialect, schema, and BLOB data types, as well as plaintext credentials. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, and managed identity replaces plaintext database credentials.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver. Update Spring datasource configuration and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle schema definitions, BLOB columns used for photo binary data to PostgreSQL bytea, and Oracle-specific repository SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents. Update datasource URLs to point to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint and replace plaintext credentials with managed identity authentication.
